overview.title: About Me

overview.services: 🌐 Websites & web applications,|📱 Mobile apps for iOS & Android,|💼 Business systems & enterprise solutions,|🛒 E-commerce & webstore platforms,|🎮 Games & interactive experiences,|🎵 Music production & audio mixing services,|🎬 Video editing & animation video commissions

projectDesc.enchantedDesc: The perfect app for plant lovers! Get watering & harvest reminders, seasonal planting guides, soil pH tips, and everything you need to grow your dream garden.
projectDesc.dcBotDesc: All-in-one discord bot for weather forecasts, AI chats, stream alerts from your favourite creator, role management, and server moderation.
projectDesc.kelxdDesc: My GitHub-Style Portfolio: this is where I show off myself. (Yep, you're on it!)
projectDesc.fbSystemDesc: Like, comment, message, and play games—just like a real person surfing on Facebook, but automated!
projectDesc.clawGameDesc: Play the viral Suika Game (Watermelon Game)… but in 360° 3D! Grab fruits, stack them, and score big—just like a real claw machine. Download and play the game in Windows!
projectDesc.qubyJumpDesc: A fast-paced 3D platformer where timing is everything. Hold [SPACE] to jump between platforms—but one wrong move and Quby takes a tumble! Can you master the rhythm? Play now in browser!
projectDesc.byylDesc: A psychological horror game delving into the isolation and creeping dread of a trapped high school student. As they cling to normalcy, the world around them twists—subtle changes corrupt the environment, interactions, and reality itself.
projectDesc.bookstoreDesc: A sleek and modern web design for a bookstore, featuring an intuitive layout, easy navigation, and a cozy aesthetic.
projectDesc.kanbanDesc: A cute & colourful Kanban board to organise tasks, set deadlines, and stop procrastination in its tracks! Create, drag, and modify tasks with ease! (Support login and cloud save in the future!)
projectDesc.weatherWizardDesc: Weather Wizard 🌦️ - Your Instant Forecast Sidekick! Type any city or country and instantly get: ☀️ Current, high & low temps | 💧 Humidity | 🌬️ Wind speed ☔ Most importantly: Will it rain today? ⏰ When?!
projectDesc.mflowDesc: A beautiful and private period tracker for iOS with accurate cycle predictions, symptom logs, sexual activity records, and personalized health insights.
projectDesc.giveupBotDesc: A Telegram mini app + bot for creating, hosting, joining, and managing events in group chats, with inline commands like /list to instantly show upcoming events.
projectDesc.stocksTrackerDesc: Track purchased HK and US stocks with position values, gain/loss analytics, buy and sell timing, and built-in financial calculation tools for smarter decisions.
projectDesc.streamerSongListDesc: A viewer request system for livestream karaoke sessions where audiences can queue songs for the streamer, powered by Spotify API integration.
projectDesc.macauCalendar: Macau Wealth Partaking Scheme Calendar Calculator
projectDesc.macauCalendarDesc: Confused about how many days you stayed in Macau in 2025? Wondering if you qualify for the 2026 benefits? This handy calendar helps you easily log and count your stay—so you’ll know exactly whether you’ve earned that 10k MOP next year! 💰💰💰💰
